fields.description: Generated automatically during install. Use Show Key, Copy Key, or Download Key below to configure the mobile app.
fields.label: Mobile API Key

fields.description: Minimum score (0 to 1) required to accept ArcFace face match from the service. Default 0.40 (ArcFace cosine).
fields.label: Minimum Face Match Score
Check-in Photo Required
fields.description: If enabled, each attendance uploads a photo (slower). Leave off for faster mobile check-in.
When off (recommended): if the employee selects a known site (e.g. doha), GPS is recorded but a wrong map pin will not block check-in. When on: phone must be inside the geofence radius.
fields.label: Strict Geofence

fields.description: Auto = first log IN, second OUT, and so on
fields.label: Log Type Mode

fields.description: Minimum minutes after Check-in before Check-out is allowed. Set 0 to allow immediate check-out. Used by ERPNext API and the mobile app.
fields.label: Min Minutes Before Check-out

fields.description: Creates ERPNext Employee Checkin when HRMS app is installed
fields.label: Sync to Employee Checkin

fields.description: Create/update HR Attendance (Present) for the day from face IN/OUT. Also enables Employee Checkin sync.
fields.label: Sync to HR Attendance

fields.description: Allow kiosk device check-in without employee login
fields.label: Kiosk Mode Enabled

fields.description: Must be ArcFace. See face_service/docs/MODEL.md
fields.label: Biometric Model Name

fields.description: ArcFace → 512 dimensions (InsightFace buffalo_l).
fields.label: Embedding Dimension

fields.description: Cosine similarity after L2 normalization. Thresholds below apply to cosine (0–1 typical for matches).
fields.label: Similarity Metric

fields.description: Reject registration only when ArcFace cosine similarity vs ANY other employee is ≥ this. ArcFace: use 0.45 (server duplicate threshold).
fields.label: Face Duplicate Threshold

fields.description: Accept attendance verification when ArcFace cosine ≥ this. ArcFace recommended 0.40. (Face service threshold is authoritative).
fields.label: Face Match Threshold

fields.description: Same employee may update without admin if new face cosine vs own template ≥ this; otherwise require re-registration approval.
fields.label: Same-Person Update Threshold

fields.description: Modular PAD/liveness. Blink/head-turn alone are not strong anti-spoofing.
fields.label: Liveness Provider

fields.description: Choose Built-in for ArcFace inside this Frappe site (no VPS). Choose External only when you already run a separate face service.
fields.label: Where should ArcFace run?

Built-in (same Frappe app)

fields.label: Recognition Engine

Setup Instructions
fields.options:
Mobile app configuration

  • Site URL: your ERPNext site (example: https://erp.example.com)
  • API Key: copy Mobile API Key from this page
  • Employees need an active Face Biometric record before face check-in
  • Config: karmavitta.api.mobile.get_config
  • Register: karmavitta.api.biometric.register_face
  • Status: karmavitta.api.biometric.get_face_registration_status
